name: csg-oits-dev
description: The Online Information Transparency System (OITS) is the official website and content management system for the Central Student Government (CSG) of Cavite State University Imus Campus. It provides CVSU-Imus students with open access to CSG announcements, official documents, event records, and officer information. Authenticated CSG administrators can create, update, and delete all content through a protected admin panel.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:backend -- --coverage && npm run test:frontend -- --coverage
